guide.title: The Roads Open Before the Unnumbered
guide.description: A continuous history from Ahn'Qiraj through Outland, Northrend, the Cataclysm, Pandaria, alternate Draenor, and the final campaign against the Burning Legion.

nodes.title: The great powers call upon unnumbered hands
nodes.narration: The age opened without a single crowned hero at its center. At Ahn'Qiraj, Alliance and Horde communities gathered a vast war effort while independent champions prepared to cross the opened gates. Their fellowship was temporary and their motives varied. Yet together these adventurers entered dangers that armies alone had not resolved, carrying the hopes of rival peoples beyond the same threshold.

nodes.title: The road crosses into a broken world
nodes.narration: The Dark Portal opened again, and the road led beneath another sky. Outland was not a distant province beyond Azeroth’s seas, but the shattered remains of Draenor. Those who crossed the threshold entered a world broken long before their arrival. Across that wounded land, old exiles, demonic powers, and new expeditions met within consequences already centuries in the making.

nodes.title: The northern crown receives its reckoning
nodes.narration: The next great campaign returned to Azeroth and climbed through Northrend toward Icecrown. Arthas had once crossed this cold seeking the strength to save his kingdom; now others followed the ruin of that choice to its throne. At the citadel's height, the Lich King's reign ended, though the burdens bound to Northrend did not vanish with him.

nodes.title: The earth remembers its betrayed guardian
nodes.narration: Then Deathwing returned, and the land itself became testimony. Coasts broke, mountains opened, and familiar lands were torn apart. The upheaval reached far beyond the armies that had fought in Northrend. Those who had survived the northern war now faced a wounded homeland, where even the earth beneath their feet could no longer promise the safety they remembered.

nodes.title: A hidden land receives an old quarrel
nodes.narration: Beyond the Cataclysm's upheaval, Pandaria returned to the wider world's knowledge. Its peoples had long kept histories, customs, and struggles of their own. Yet Alliance and Horde carried their rivalry ashore, drawing an ancient land into the quarrels of distant powers. Beneath unfamiliar skies, the war found new ground, and those who already called it home would bear its consequences.

nodes.title: The war turns upon its own warchief
nodes.narration: The conflict carried home from Pandaria did not leave the Horde whole. Opposition to Garrosh's rule gathered within it while Alliance forces advanced upon Orgrimmar. Their purposes met in a siege that ended his leadership, without reconciling every grievance. The struggle divided obedience from belonging. Those who had stood against the warchief still faced the harder task of living with what his rule had left behind.

nodes.title: History opens beside itself
nodes.narration: The next invasion came from an alternate Draenor, a world that had not suffered the destruction that made Outland. There, iron and ambition had formed the Iron Horde. A familiar name now belonged to a different course of history, and beyond Azeroth's sky another host prepared to carry its war into the world.

nodes.title: The ancient enemy returns to the Broken Isles
nodes.narration: From the alternate war's ending rose the way for an older enemy to return. The Burning Legion invaded through the Broken Isles. Established armies could not answer every wound, and distinct class orders gathered champions according to calling rather than kingdom. Many traditions answered the same danger. Beside them stood Illidan, carrying his own long and perilous history into the defense.

nodes.title: The defenders carry the war to Argus
nodes.narration: Defense became pursuit, and pursuit crossed the dark between worlds. On Argus, the Legion's power had left a shattered realm of broken plateaus and fel-lit wounds. There, old exiles, the Army of the Light, Illidan, and Azeroth's champions struck at the Legion's seat. The defenders had carried the war beyond their own sky, into the heart of the power that had pursued them.

nodes.title: Victory returns to a wounded world
nodes.narration: The Legion's immediate crusade was broken on Argus, and the age of far roads reached its sternest victory. Yet those roads led home to no untouched morning. Azeroth had endured the Scourge, the Cataclysm, faction war, and powers from beyond its sky. The champions who had crossed so many thresholds returned to a world whose wounds would become causes in their own right—and whose next war would begin before healing was complete.
